## Fixed
- **Capture Net is now correctly listed for Minecraft 1.21.11.** The previous 1.21.11 releases (v0.3.0 and v0.3.1) were published under the wrong Minecraft version by mistake — they were labelled 26.1.x. Because of that, Minecraft 1.21.11 had no download of its own, and players on 26.1.x could be handed a 1.21.11 build that refused to load, with an error saying the mod required Minecraft 1.21.11 — on both Fabric and NeoForge.

## Notes
- No gameplay changes — this build is identical to v0.3.1. The files were always built correctly for 1.21.11; only the published labels were wrong.
- Playing on Minecraft 26.1.x? Use the `+mc26.1.2` download instead of this one.
- This was a packaging mistake, not a problem with your setup.
